description: Defaults for every onboarded project. A project's renovate.json extends local>GROUP/PROJECT (this repository).

packageRules.description: A major version lands as its own merge request, never grouped.

Container registries (and OCI Helm charts, which use the same datasource) often publish no release timestamp, and internal mirrors almost never do. Renovate 42+ holds a timestamp-less release forever under minimumReleaseAge; for these, apply the cooldown only where a timestamp exists.
